# P019 — Default-emitted full transparency renders objects invisible

**Sender**: FreeCAD 0.21.x, VariCAD, Fusion (re-export round-trip)  

## Sources
- FreeCAD #18569, #18575

## Description

STEP files written with `SURFACE_STYLE_RENDERING_WITH_PROPERTIES(... transparency = 1.0 ...)` for every face — even when the producer treated this as "not specified" — render as wireframe / invisible in viewers that honor transparency.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file with per-face rendering properties having transparency=1.0.

## Expected kernel behavior

Default transparency 0 unless explicitly set; receiver should also flag improbable all-transparent files.
